modules.title: Source profiling queries
modules.scope: Builds usp_profile_custtrans_grain and usp_profile_corp_subscription_status, count-only procedures over the external sources, so Mike can run them before the invoice build (Q-021, Q-027). Builds no tables and changes no existing object.

modules.title: Subscription invoice bronze
modules.scope: Builds brnz_subs_invoice and brnz_subs_invoice_line and their load procedures: 1:1 landing with soft delete, row-count check and logging, and the RULE-077 line scope. Does not interpret line types or payment modes.

modules.title: Payment method reference and dimension
modules.scope: Builds the seeded silv_ref_payment_method (reserved ids 0, -1, -2 plus the five methods), fn_map_payment_method (code to id per RULE-007 to RULE-009), dim_payment_method and its load. Does not derive any contact's payment method.

modules.title: Corporate subscription bronze and payer type reference
modules.scope: Builds brnz_corporate_subscription and its load (Round not landed), the seeded silv_ref_payer_type, dim_payer_type and its load. Does not derive payer type.

modules.title: Invoice line-type mapping and currency
modules.scope: Builds silv_ref_invoice_line_type (seeded curated mapping; new codes added as 'unmapped', mapped rows never overwritten), silv_ref_currency, dim_currency and their three loads. Does not compute amounts.

modules.title: Concession reference and dimension
modules.scope: Builds brnz_concession and its load, silv_ref_concession_type (seeded reserved rows and No concession, insert-and-update from bronze, item_code, is_full_concession, is_perpetual) with its load, and dim_concession_type with its load. Also carries the cross-segment reserved-label check over the three segment lists. Does not derive concessions for contacts.

modules.title: Member-year attributes and new event-table columns
modules.scope: Builds vw_silv_eligible_invoice (RULE-014, RULE-079), silv_member_year_attributes and its load: payment method, payer type, corporate_account_ref and concession per contact-year, with carry-forward and pre-2022 rules. Also adds the seventeen new columns (keys and flags not null with default 0; amounts, currency_id and amount_status nullable) to the existing silv_membership_events and fact_membership_events, through change scripts the down script reverses exactly, without writing values or changing any Phase 1 column, row, event_nk or event_id. Does not write anomalies or event values.

modules.title: Segment anomalies
modules.scope: Builds usp_load_silv_data_anomaly_segment, which reconciles CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME, DOUBLE_PAYMENT, CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE and FULL_CONCESSION_NO_CONCESSION rows in the existing silv_data_anomaly (structure unchanged). Does not touch other anomaly types.

modules.title: Retire silv_payment_events.payment_source
modules.scope: Removes payment_source from the existing silv_payment_events through a change script, and changes the existing Phase 1 procedure that loads it so it no longer writes the column (procedure named under Q-031; drop approval Q-035). The down script restores both. No other change.

modules.title: Event invoice matching and amounts
modules.scope: Builds silv_event_amount and usp_load_silv_event_amount: amount Campaign Year, date-order pairing of events with eligible invoices (including shortfall and surplus cases), subs, fee, subtotal, credit, GBP and net amounts, currency and amount_status per Join, Renewal and Readmission. Does not write to the event tables or to silv_data_anomaly.

modules.title: Invoice and readmission anomalies
modules.scope: Builds usp_load_silv_data_anomaly_invoice, which reconciles EVENT_NO_INVOICE, INVOICE_NO_EVENT, INVOICE_MATCHES_MULTIPLE_EVENTS, EVENT_MATCHES_MULTIPLE_INVOICES, READMISSION_FREE and READMISSION_NO_FEE rows for amount Campaign Years from 2022, using the Campaign Year quarter 2 free window (ADR-004, Q-032). Does not touch other anomaly types.

modules.title: Segment keys, flags and amounts onto the events
modules.scope: Builds usp_load_silv_membership_events_segments (keys and flags from silv_member_year_attributes, amounts from silv_event_amount) and usp_load_fact_membership_events_segments (copy to gold by event_id plus the extended silver-to-gold check), per ADR-001. Changes no Phase 1 column, row or procedure.

modules.title: Retirement comparison query
modules.scope: Builds usp_report_retirement_comparison: four counts and the agreement rate by Campaign Year over paid positions, aggregates only. No change to Practising / Retired logic.

modules.title: Employer findings queries
modules.scope: Builds the three count-only employer findings procedures (scheme-link coverage, source agreement, top employers). Creates no employer table, dimension or column. The Technical Writer's update for this module carries the employer data quality note.

modules.title: Coverage and totals queries
modules.scope: Builds the four count-only report procedures (payment method coverage, invoiced subtotal coverage, Direct Debit share, last full year totals), each with an as-of date parameter (ADR-003). Aggregates only.

modules.title: Run sequence, regression and handover completion
modules.scope: Builds usp_run_payment_segments, which runs every new load in dependency order after the Phase 1 run. Proves end to end on synthetic data that Phase 1 results are unchanged, that a second full run changes nothing, and that every migration passes check and roundtrip. Its documentation update completes the handover and Platform Schema content. Changes no Phase 1 object; a human schedules the run (Q-031).
